The '''Mhalanduin system''' was located in the [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Mhalanduin Reformation]],<ref name="Author">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref> an event that occurred at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}} establishes that [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] was alive by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Mhalanduin Reformation]] took place. Furthermore, the novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] places Motti aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] during its [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, the Mhalanduin Reformation must have occurred by that date.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mhalanduin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square R-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
